title: Next Reply Prediction X Dataset: Linguistic Discrepancies in Naively Generated Content

bias_targets.methodology: Applying semantic classification models (e.g., twitter-RoBERTa-base-emotion from the TweetEval benchmark) to analyze emotion distributions, revealing that LLM-generated content systematically skews toward positive emotion classifications compared to authentic human content.

Using the NeLa (News Landscape) feature suite to extract and quantify linguistic profiles across five dimensions (complexity, style, bias, affect, and moral reasoning patterns) to measure the distance between human and synthetic social media texts.
